title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Qode Interactive…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Qode Interactive Qi Addons For Elementor versions up to 1.11.2. This vulnerability involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation, which could allow an attacker with limited privileges to execute malicious scripts in the context of other users. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 6.5.
